candidates.description: As part of Massachusetts STEM Week, Lt. Governor Karyn Polito joins Josh Kraft, the Patriots Hall of Fame and Raytheon Technologies to celebrate Becky Colo, the Massachusetts STEM Teacher of the Year, at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough on Oct. 20, 2021. Colo teaches at Longsjo Middle School in Fitchburg. [Joshua Qualls/Governor’s Press Office]
categories: Celebration of Becky Colo as Massachusetts STEM Teacher of the Year (October 20, 2021)

candidates.description: "Governor Healey celebrates upcoming Army-Navy game’s historic arrival in New England Governor Maura Healey joins Secretary of Veterans’ Services Jon Santiago and New England Patriots President Jonathan Kraft to celebrate the upcoming Army-Navy college football game’s historic arrival in New England during a press conference at Gillette Stadium on Nov. 29, 2023. The game will be played 3 p.m. Dec.
